summary.name: Translucent Tissue-Paper Collage (Printmaking and Craft Materials; extracted 2026-10-12)
summary.visualIdentity: Overlapping translucent tissue fibers, torn edges and colored layers create underwater depth. Light must transmit through overlaps, not read as opaque cardstock. Reference subjects include fish, kelp and light shafts.
summary.suitableUses: Inferred: underwater subjects and layered, craft-textured depth scenes. Subject, audience, objective, duration and format are unspecified in the source and must come from the brief.
summary.limitations: Palette is limited to supplied tokens unless approved tissue colors are given; report that gap. Two-color contrast ignores textures, transmitted light and video backgrounds. Simulated appearance is not validated physical production.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene_dependent; #172D3A is an authored underwater fallback, not an approved exact color. Foreground #F2EEE1 yields 12.284:1 contrast for opaque captions. Gradients are disabled. Background evidence is a single fog poster, not full-video verification.
summary.motionAndInteraction: GSAP tweens sway, depth-scaled drift parallax and layer laydown on a paused, registered timeline, with each frame redrawn. The 3-second preview settles layers into slow overlapping drift. No interactive HTML behavior is specified.
summary.audio: Unspecified: no music, voice or effects are supplied. Direction must be inferred from topic, audience and motion cadence, with no fixed genre or tempo. Ambience or silence may suit reading holds; verify any speech.
summary.assetRequirements: No assets are required; optional inputs are task exact colors, approved tissue colors and authorized audio. Tissue shapes are authored polygons with seeded torn edges. Fonts and assets must load before rendering.
summary.combinations: Suggested secondary: style-101 for restrained layer depth. Style-124 stays dominant; the supporting style must not import its palette or replace the verified background. Avoid competing full-scene treatments.
summary.productionApproach: Canvas 2D is the style renderer, using source-over alpha near 0.45–0.6 and multiply fiber overlays; GSAP is the motion engine. HyperFrames is the default pipeline, with Remotion only for a verified fallback. Verify snapshots and decoded frames.
